meta.title: Repo wiki
meta.description: Index a repository into a Git-shareable symbol-level knowledge base (.dsh-repowiki): deterministic symbol indexing, LLM knowledge cards and wiki synthesis, cross-session query, snapshot import/export, session-memory review, and a workspace-level GUI panel with a sidebar entry. Tools: repowiki-index, repowiki-cards, repowiki-extract, repowiki-generate, repowiki-edit, repowiki-export, repowiki-import, repowiki-memory.
